key_concepts: Oxygen travels from outside the body through the nasal cavity, pharynx, trachea, bronchi,
The nasal cavity moistens and filters air as it is inhaled
The trachea is lined with cilia that filter air before it reaches the lungs
The pharynx is the passageway that leads to the trachea
The bronchi are branches that lead to the lungs
The bronchioles are small branches that lead to the air sacs
The alveoli are where oxygen enters the blood and carbon dioxide is removed from the blood
Oxygen is inhaled through the nostrils and is used during cellular respiration
Carbon dioxide is a waste product removed by the respiratory system
The lung is the major organ associated with the human respiratory system

Emphysema involves over-distention and destruction of the air spaces in the lungs
